author: Kushal
problem: Read N and three lists of N integers: Q (grams available of each ingredient), A and B (grams of each ingredient needed per serving of dish A and of dish B). Print the maximum total number of servings of A and B that can be made.
bug_description: Caps y with x instead of the running y, so the minimum over ingredients is lost and the servings of B are limited by x.

comments.accurate: Tries every count x of dish A and adds the most servings of B the leftovers allow
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries every count x of dish A and adds up to x servings of B from the leftovers
comments.wrong_location: Leftover division verified; check the -inf case when an ingredient runs short
